AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Prompt Departure (also known as Departure Board or Departure) provides live public transport departure boards, train and bus countdowns, and live journey tracking for UK/London transit. Operational Patterns: - Use 'getLiveDepartures' when the user asks for upcoming trains, buses, departures, or timetables at a station. - Use 'trackDeparture' when the user asks to track a journey or train countdown to a destination. - Use 'pinStation' when the user asks to save, bookmark, or pin a station to their dashboard. - Use 'requestWidgetPin' when the user asks to add a station widget to their home screen. Constraints: - stationName must be provided for all queries. - Destination is required for trackDeparture.
